newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-MERKO CONSTRUCTION LAUNCHES REAL ESTATE COMPANY.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-MERKO CONSTRUCTION LAUNCHES REAL ESTATE COMPANY.

text.p: The construction company Merko Ehitus said on Monday it had established a real estate subsidiary called Merko Kinnisvara.
The subsidiary, 100 percent owned by Merko, has a share capital of 10 million kroons, it added in a statement.
The subsidiary's first project will be renting out a building to Electrolux Estonia which will be built by Merko Ehitus.
The new building costs 42 million kroons and construction is due to start in September.
